student_affairs_cell.name: Office of Dean Students Affairs
student_affairs_cell.role: Nodal center for promoting student camaraderie, overall personality growth, extracurricular initiatives, talent discovery, and maintaining collegiate discipline.

nss_national_service_scheme.name: National Service Scheme (NSS) Cell
nss_national_service_scheme.overview: Affiliated with RTMNU and the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, the NSS unit instills social civic responsibility, empathy, and volunteerism.
major_activities: Annual 7-day Special Rural Residential Camp in nearby adopted villages
Mega Blood Donation Camps in collaboration with recognized blood banks
Tree Plantation drives (Van Mahotsav) on campus and local areas
Swachh Bharat Abhiyan cleanliness drives and plastic-free campus campaigns
Health hygiene awareness, pulse polio, and traffic safety awareness rallies

ncc_national_cadet_corps.name: NCC Activities
ncc_national_cadet_corps.overview: Encourages students to cultivate military discipline, national service ethos, physical fitness, and leadership training, preparing students for Armed Forces careers.

sports_cell.name: Institute Sports Cell
activities: Annual Inter-Departmental Sports Meet (Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess, Athletics)
Participation in RTMNU Inter-Collegiate University Tournaments
Sports Incentive Marks Policy as per RTMNU and Autonomous guidelines

technical_clubs_and_forums.name: ACES (Association of Computer Engineering Students)
technical_clubs_and_forums.activities: Coding competitions, web development hackathons, technical paper presentations, and guest lectures.

technical_clubs_and_forums.name: MESA (Mechanical Engineering Students Association)
technical_clubs_and_forums.activities: CAD modeling contests, robotics workshops, industrial visits, and national vehicle design challenges.

technical_clubs_and_forums.name: ELESA (Electrical Engineering Students Association)
technical_clubs_and_forums.activities: Circuit design competitions, renewable energy model exhibits, and electrical safety workshops.

technical_clubs_and_forums.name: IEEE Student Branch & IEEE PES (Power & Energy Society)
technical_clubs_and_forums.activities: International webinars, technical paper symposiums, and research seminars (awarded Best PES Day Activity Award).

technical_clubs_and_forums.name: Robotics & Innovation Club
technical_clubs_and_forums.activities: Autonomous bot fabrication, IoT workshops, line follower robot races, and drone building.

cultural_and_annual_festivals.technotsav: Annual National Level Technical Festival featuring coding marathons, robotics combat, paper presentations, and project exhibitions.
cultural_and_annual_festivals.manthan: Annual Cultural Extravaganza and college magazine showcasing music, dance, theatrical drama, fashion show, literary arts, and student creative writing.

alumni_association.name: SBJITMR Alumni Cell
alumni_association.role: Organizes annual alumni reunions, alumni mentorship talks, mock interviews, and student career guidance sessions.
